rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a great many people, such as accountants, rather than for a military unit.

example.english: There is a legion of people queuing at the venue entrance.
example.traditional: 會場門口有一大班人排緊隊。
example.jyutping: wui2 coeng4 mun4 hau2 jau5 jat1 daai6 baan1 jan4 paai4 gan2 deoi6

rows.note: Use this for the Roman army division and for similarly named modern or historical combined-arms military units.

example.english: A Roman legion was usually made up of several thousand infantry and cavalry soldiers.
example.traditional: 古羅馬軍團通常由幾千名步兵同埋騎兵組成。
example.jyutping: gu2 lo4 maa5 gwan1 tyun4 tung1 soeng4 jau4 gei2 cin1 ming4 bou6 bing1 tung4 maai4 ke4 bing1 zou2 sing4

rows.jyutping: teoi3 ng5 gwan1 jan4 hip3 wui2
rows.note: Use this for an organization of former servicemen, such as the American Legion, not for an army unit.

example.english: My uncle joined the American Legion.
example.traditional: 我阿叔加入咗美國退伍軍人協會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 suk1 gaa1 jap6 zo2 mei5 gwok3 teoi3 ng5 gwan1 jan4 hip3 wui2
